question: Does O's observation input representation still help when it is placed on a different, independently stable backbone?
backbone: official PointNeXt-S (same implementation and recipe as the completed C-group formal runs)
adaptation: O's input-fusion block (identical RGDIFusion, embed_ch=32, gate_bias=0.3, learned gate, no explicit quality modulation, no reliability descriptors) placed at the PointNeXt-S stem; encoder_args.in_channels 4 -> 36; observation prior identical to O (degraded raster; restored/reliability zero); NO internal injection because PointNeXt SA stages differ from RandLA - recorded as an input-fusion adaptation, not as full O
optimizer: AdamW, weight_decay=1e-4, gradient norm clipping=1, cosine lr to 0.05*initial
precision: FP32 with TF32 disabled (independent-backbone recipe; not a precision-matched ablation)
validation: existing split and seed 42, fixed sampled evaluation, all dataset classes
selection: maximum best medium-validation mIoU; ties keep the earlier epoch; frozen before any test
smoke: 1 epoch, at most 12 train and 4 validation batches; smoke never produces a paper checkpoint
